Claim: PM loop round 9 — flight F2, the maintainer's 插队 (「16551 插队」, live PM chat 2026-09-07T08:5xZ), dispatched ahead of the seat's wind-down: the five measured refinements to the finding admission threshold (#16351's follow-up) — (1) read current state before every write, three ⛔ lines in the 发现分诊轮 block; (2) the acceptance-notes fallback needs a named carrier, four lines, 「承接者:无」 on a close without one; (3) three criterion boundaries written down beside the three classes (carrier of the key; the third failure mode; docs as a carrier = incomplete vs wrong); (4) the irreversibility gate, one line before the 三类外关 not planned line; (5) #16351's acceptance metric replaced by one that can fail (a 20-sample re-judgement a week after landing) — every pinned file line-neutral by offsetting folds, the implementing dev's call.
Session: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`
Branch: `claude/issue-16551-finding-threshold-refinements`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-16551`
Domain: `domain:skills` (self-triaged by this seat; graded `priority:p1` on the maintainer's 插队)
File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (the 发现分诊轮 block and the three-class lines; pin 811), `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (the three-class lines at 42–45; pin 403), `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/core-rules.md` (the threshold line at 89; pin 150), and the one reference file the dev measures as the carrier of item 5's procedure if SKILL.md cannot hold it line-neutrally (its own pin). ⛔ No other file; no issue numbers in the corpus; rules only.
Container & model: L, `mode:subagent`, fable — `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: MANDATORY on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`; on a fable 429 the seat's exemption applies, opus, recorded here.
Clause-②: no
Serial: every open PR that touches any of the three files is enumerated in the brief; before the final push the dev proves `merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` clean against each of their heads from a driver-less bare clone (the AGENTS.md corollary; ⛔ never a `-c merge.os-regen.driver=` override); not clean ⇒ stop at the draft and report blocked. Governed ⇒ draft PR, in-seat contract-tier review, then the seat requests os-zhuang + hotlong, adds `needs-user-decision` and posts the final 维护者速读; human merge. The PR carries `Fixes #16551`.

ACCEPT — flight F2, PR #16557 at head `6e31ed35bb` (#16551, the maintainer's 插队 「16551 插队」), contract-tier review in seat; the dev's report is 5568406679.

Read in a detached compare worktree against the base `f48f3f1b21`; every reading below is the seat's own, taken on the head.

- Diff: 4 files, 16 insertions / 16 deletions, text only; every pinned file at its pin with headroom 0 — SKILL.md 811 · os-dev.md 403 · core-rules.md 150 · dispatch-runbook.md 241 (`check-skill-line-ratchet` live + self-test 157 cases); every added line under the 120-byte cap (measured over the diff); `check-skill-id-lint` 26 files clean; `check-skill-frame-sync` isomorphic; `check-governed-merges --test` on the four paths → 4 of 4 hit the register, GOVERNED, exit 3.
- Item 1 (read before write): three ⛔ lines in the 发现分诊轮 block — current-state read before every write with list snapshots void; cards carrying `pm:dispatched`, an assignee or any open or merged PR reference untouched; `issue_write` replaces the label set and clears unpassed fields so `assignees` is passed back. The ledger already holds the labels half at platform-readings.md 195; the cleared-fields half is a rider for the sixth readings increment (noted on #13326 by the seat).
- Item 2 (named carrier): the seat half beside the three classes (ask which PR or person will touch the file; no answer ⇒ the fallback does not hold; close anyway with 「承接者:无」), the dev half at os-dev.md's `noted, not filed` line. The card's 6-of-6 measurement is the ground.
- Item 3 (three boundaries): (a) is incomplete versus wrong, not docs versus code; (c)'s metadata is a key stored and re-authored by someone other than its writer; a warning steering an author to metadata the runtime honours and that makes things worse is recorded as the boundary, not widened into (c). One line each in SKILL.md and os-dev.md, one summary line in core-rules.md.
- Item 4 (irreversibility gate): one line before 「每批先验三类…」 — irreversible or hard-deadlined out-of-class items (fixed at release, consumed-only files, unrecoverable after the window) are not closed but reported to the maintainer; triggers on the thing's window only, no uncertainty trigger.
- Item 5 (a failable acceptance): the 20-sample re-judgement a week after landing, in dispatch-runbook.md beside the batch conventions the 发现分诊轮 line already routes to; a parameterised seat procedure, not a dev rule.
- Folds: 16 restated lines removed, each quoted in the PR body with the line that carries its content; the seat re-read the risky ones on the head — the PM-writes-no-files rule (SKILL.md 24, core-rules 23), assignee-not-yours-never-touch (SKILL.md 105 · 466, core-rules 29), the `AGENTS.md` precedence (the 优先序 line), the needs-user-decision never-dispatch/never-answer rule (SKILL.md 29 · 107, core-rules 10), the stall criterion (SKILL.md 583 on the PM side; os-dev.md 干净收尾 on the dev side). The three-class frame, 「三类外关 not planned(不等批准…)」, 「定级即离标」, the native `type` lines and the English audit line are untouched, as the card required.
- Serial: only PR #16271 (devx, draft, dirty) touches these files; the driver-less bare-clone probe is clean against `origin/main` and conflicts in SKILL.md against #16271's head 4d3194ba74 — recorded, not a landing condition; whichever merges second re-folds (#16271 already owes one).
- Gates: dispatch-gates derived 17 families, 17 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; whole-repo lint through the verify lock exit 0; nul-bytes clean; `check-clause2-carriers` 190 and `check-half-states` 2636 self-tests pass.
- CI on `6e31ed35bb`: 29 check runs, 17 success + 12 skipped, none red (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check` and its four legs, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, both single-claim guards and `Part-of PR must not also close its card` all green).
